goal: Implement Task 3 of the approved integrated plan: pure solid-entity collision, snapping, swept rigid-set movement and a non-persistent versioned spatial index.
non_goals: Do not integrate collision sessions into the React canvas editor; that belongs to Task 5.
Do not implement nearest-free placement; that belongs to Task 4.
Do not add or upgrade dependencies.
Do not change chat, AI runtime, credentials, persistence, packaging or release behavior.
Do not read, print or modify provider credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Collision thresholds convert 6px safety gap, 8px snap entry, 14px snap break and 0.25px epsilon through one captured viewport snapshot.
Solid classification excludes freehand and group nodes while treating unknown future card types as solid.
AABB normalization rejects non-finite geometry and collision checks apply the safety expansion and epsilon contract.
Active-edge snapping supports independent x/y hysteresis with deterministic node-ID tie-breaking.
Swept rigid-set movement chooses earliest contact, prevents tunnelling through a one-pixel corridor and performs at most four deterministic axis-sliding passes.
Legacy-conflict scoring, rigid multi-select rectangles and finite-number rejection follow the approved pure-policy contract.
CanvasSpatialIndex supports rebuild, upsert, remove and query with geometryVersion records and a monotonically increasing version.
Focused collision and spatial-index tests, the canvas suite, TypeScript check and diff check pass.
The implementation is committed and independently reviewed for spec compliance and task quality.
notes: Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for every non-ASCII read, search, edit and test output.
Follow strict TDD and record the expected missing-module failures before implementation.
Keep both new modules pure, deterministic and independent of React and persistent stores.
Use the Task 2 viewport sizing contract as the only screen-to-canvas threshold conversion boundary.
Do not expose or change configured provider secrets.
